label: a1 trial after an unrewarded rare transition (D1 and D2 at S1)
explanation: This unit is the low end of candidate unit 5, and it is tied to action a1. It fires only on trials where the agent chooses a1 (100% of the activation mass has action==1), never on a rewarded D1 input (in_rew==1), and almost never at D2 when S2 is shown (S2 holds 0.2% of the mass). It is strongest after unrewarded previous trials (prev_reward==0 holds 85% of the mass), especially rare unrewarded ones (prev_common==0 holds 66% of the mass). In those cases the previous a1 choice ended in S2 with no reward, which is evidence that S1 is good, so the agent stays on a1. It fires at that D1 and at the following D2 when S1 is shown. After that the activation decays over the next rewarded a1 trials: GO and D2 show weak tails such as 0.4, then 0.26, then 0.04. GO carries only about 10% of the mass. Activity also falls with episode time (it is near zero after trial 80) and grows with the policy logit toward a1 and with value. The predicate uses action at D1, which is the agent own upcoming choice and so a legitimate variable; it uses no future reward or transition. Broader predicates such as action==1 & prev_reward==0 & D1/D2 reach mass recall 0.84 but precision 0.38. The recorded rare-unrewarded version has the best F1 (about 0.56 on dev). The decaying persistence and the episode-time dependence are not captured.
